items.html: Know that the essential place of the worlds and their degree in truth is thus, according to this order, and this is the place fitting for them to always be. And the reason is that ZA needs to grow and become like Arich Anpin, and if so he needs to rise up to there; and the place of Arich Anpin must become the place of ZA, for through this ZA is made "long" (Arich).
